title: Breaking the Mirror: Activation-Based Mitigation of Self-Preference in LLM Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise evaluation where a model acts as a judge comparing its own generated summary against another model's summary. The evaluating model's selections are compared against ground-truth consensus from a panel of independent 'gold' judge models to separate illegitimate self-preference from legitimate quality differences.
Running pairwise evaluation prompts twice with different candidate orderings to detect and discard evaluation items where the model's preference is dictated by the presentation order.
